moriarty_da.text: Come in, we are mad for company. 'Slán abhaile' is 'safe home', and I say it to every boat.
A Gannetling folds its wings and dives from a great height. They can plunge 30 metres, and the Plungebeak does it in style.
My nephew was named Fungie, after the dolphin. He says he is the second most famous Fungie in the harbour.
